subject: Sandpit AI — request for temporary sandbox credit
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@sandpit.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary sandbox credit to salvage pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the time last week — the team at Sandpit is excited about the latency numbers you showed on Redwood, but we ran into an unexpected blocker: our security review delayed our infra changes and our trial tokens expired mid-eval. We still have an active pilot (POC) with two product teams and need another 30 days of sandbox access to finish validity checks.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short-term credit uplift so we can complete the evaluation? Specifically, we are asking for 10,000 generation tokens (approx) credited to our sandbox for 30 days.

I've attached a usage export and a one-pager (sandbox-usage-report.csv, sandpit-exec-summary.pdf) that shows the remaining tests and expected token burn. If helpful, we can sign a short MSA addendum or accept promo terms.

Appreciate any help — this pilot is the leading candidate for standardizing inference across our product line and we'd like to avoid restarting the procurement clock.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Platform, Sandpit AI
elena@sandpit.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@sandpit.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary sandbox credit to salvage pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the attachments (received).

Short answer: we can often support short bridge credits for pilots, but I need to confirm internally on the amount and any contractual terms. Two immediate asks from my side:

- Can you confirm the Org ID for the trial (so we apply the credit correctly)?
- Is Sandpit comfortable with a conditional credit (e.g., 5k token bridge now, with an additional uplift on executive sign-off or when a procurement PO is issued)?

I"m looping in Marcus (solutions) to confirm the technical side and Monica (finance) to surface any billing/terms constraints. I expect to come back with a proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@sandpit.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sandpit AI — request for temporary sandbox credit

FYI — forwarding Sandpit's request. Key points:

- Strategic fit: Sandpit is evaluating for a company-wide standardization of inference (multiple teams). Potential ARR (if they convert) ~ $120k/year.
- Current ask: 10k tokens for 30 days; they are open to signing promo terms.
- They had an internal security delay — not a usage misuse.

Proposed options:
A) Approve a 5,000 token bridge today (30-day window) while procurement completes.
B) Approve full 10,000 on the condition of a signed MSA addendum or a committed PO within 45 days.

Marcus — can you confirm whether the sandbox token assign is straightforward for their Org ID? Monica — from finance, is option A within our promo authority or do we need manager approval? If we can do A quickly it buys time for procurement and keeps the pilot momentum.

Attachments: sandbox-usage-report.csv, sandpit-exec-summary.pdf (from Elena)

—Sean
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@sandpit.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandpit AI — request for temporary sandbox credit

Sean / Marcus / Elena —

Thanks for the details. Finance approves a conditional promo grant to preserve pipeline momentum. Here's what we can offer immediately:

- 5,000 token credit applied to Sandpit AI's sandbox Org ID for 45 days.
- If a PO or signed addendum referencing promo terms is received within 30 days, we will consider a one-time uplift to the full 10,000 tokens (non-recurring).
- Promo terms: sandbox-credit-terms.pdf (attached) — standard non-recourse trial credit, non-transferable.

Elena: to process the credit I need the Org ID and the billing contact email. I will initiate the credit once we have those; the DocuSign link below covers the short promo terms we need signed (simple, one-page).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/iframe?documentId=ABC123
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/34821

If you accept, I will apply the 5k credit today and set the 45-day expiry.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
